camel_example: aliyun csas CreateDynamicRoute --region cn-hangzhou --Status Disabled --ApplicationType Application --Priority 99 --NextHop 'connector-8ccb13b6f52c0000' --DynamicRouteType connector --RegionIds.1 'ap-southeast-1' --Name dynamic_route_name --method POST --force
description_en: Create dynamic routes for the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 创建当前阿里云账号下创建动态路由
kebab_example: aliyun csas create-dynamic-route --name dynamic_route_name --status Disabled --priority 99 --region-ids ap-southeast-1 --application-type Application --dynamic-route-type connector --next-hop connector-8ccb13b6f52c0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDynamicRoute

parameters.help_en: The dynamic route name. It is 1 to 128 characters long. It supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The dynamic route description. It is 1 to 128 characters long. It supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The dynamic route status. Valid values:

Enabled: Enabled.

Disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
动态路由状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The dynamic route priority. 1 indicates the highest priority. Valid values: 1-99
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由优先级。数字1表示优先级最高。取值：1-99
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: A list of regions supported by SASE POP cluster access points
parameters.help_zh: SASE的POP集群接入点支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_ids

parameters.help_en:
The application type of the dynamic route. Valid values:

All: All applications.

Application: Application.

Tag: Tag
parameters.help_zh:
动态路由的应用类型。取值：
All：全部应用。
Application：应用。
Tag：标签
parameters.name: application_type

parameters.help_en: A collection of internal network access application IDs for the dynamic route. You can enter a maximum of 200 internal network access application IDs. Required when ApplicationType is Application. Choose one of ApplicationIds or TagIds. Do not enter when ApplicationType is All
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由的内网访问应用ID集合。最多可输入200个内网访问应用ID。当ApplicationType为Application时，必填。和TagIds二选一。当ApplicationType为All时，禁止输入
parameters.name: application_ids

parameters.help_en: A collection of internal network access tag IDs for the dynamic route. You can enter a maximum of 40 internal network access tag IDs. Required when ApplicationType is Tag. Choose one of ApplicationIds or TagIds. Do not enter when ApplicationType is All
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由的内网访问标签ID集合。最多可输入40个内网访问标签ID。当ApplicationType为Tag时，必填。和ApplicationIds二选一。当ApplicationType为All时，禁止输入
parameters.name: tag_ids

parameters.help_en: The dynamic route type. Valid values: connector: Leased line
parameters.help_zh: 动态路由类型。取值：connector：自有专线
parameters.name: dynamic_route_type

parameters.help_en:
The next hop instance ID of the dynamic route. Source:

For more information, see [ListConnectors](): Query Connectors in batches
parameters.help_zh:
动态路由下一跳实例ID。取值来源：
https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/611545.html：批量查询Connector
parameters.name: next_hop
